description: Optional Unified Clans goblin ponyrider faction overlay for the Lewd Handbook: capture, training phases, clan marks and piercings.

campaignOptions.description: Enable the Goblin Ponyriders / Unified Clans overlay (capture, Defiance Clock, Clan Mark, training roles). off keeps verbs inert. High-stakes content: pair with LewdHandbook lewdNonConsent and hard limits. Adults only.
Comma-separated tags this plugin always refuses (e.g. capture, pony, breeding, clan_mark, terror_release). Stacks with LewdHandbook lewdHardLimits.
